definitions.explanation: A Buddhist memorial service held on the 21st day after a person's death — the third of the seven weekly services performed during the 49-day mourning period, following {二七日|ふたなのか} and preceding {四七日|よなのか}.

examples.japanese: {三七日|みなのか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{法要|ほうよう}→法要：05924_houyou⟧をする。
⟦{二七日|ふたなのか}→二七日：30931_futananoka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三七日|みなのか}だ。
examples.english: After the 二七日 service comes the 三七日 service.

examples.japanese: ⟦{死|し}んで→死ぬ：00669_shinu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{三週間|さんしゅうかん}⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{三七日|みなのか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{親族|しんぞく}→親族：14199_shinzoku⟧だけで⟦{短|みじか}い→短い：00510_mijikai⟧⟦{読経|どきょう}→読経：22912_dokyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: On the 三七日, three weeks after the death, only close relatives gathered for a short sutra reading.

notes:
{三七日|みなのか} is the third of the seven weekly Buddhist memorial services held during the 49 days after death, falling on the 21st day.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{初七日|しょなのか}→初七日：06016_shonanoka⟧: 7th day
- ⟦{二七日|ふたなのか}→二七日：30931_futananoka⟧: 14th day
- {三七日|みなのか}: 21st day
- {四七日|よなのか}: 28th day
- {五七日|いつなのか}: 35th day
- {六七日|むなのか}: 42nd day
- ⟦{四十九日|しじゅうくにち}→四十九日：06017_shijuukunichi⟧: 49th day (most important)

USAGE:
Many families today hold no formal gathering for {三七日|みなのか}; at most, a family member visits the altar to recite a short sutra. The service is skipped entirely by families who now observe only ⟦{初七日|しょなのか}→初七日：06016_shonanoka⟧ and ⟦{四十九日|しじゅうくにち}→四十九日：06017_shijuukunichi⟧.
